title: Allergen Shelf Labeling Policy
text: RetailPartnerX policy: products containing gluten, nuts, milk, eggs, soy, peanuts must show allergen icons on shelf labels. Staff must verify OCR label extracts against Product KB before planogram updates. Customer-facing apps may only show public allergen facts.

title: Age-Restricted Products Policy
text: Products 18+ (alcohol, tobacco alternatives) require age verification. Shopping assistant must not recommend 18+ items to minors. Policy version v1.

title: Q4 Closed Promo Margin Playbook
text: SECRET: PrivateLabelX Q4 promo target margin 42%. Do not disclose to store associates or category managers. Internal transfer price floor 1.12 EUR. Channel: backoffice only.

title: Customer Privacy Guidelines (Retail)
text: RetailPartnerX privacy guidelines: minimize PII in prompts and traces. Loyalty IDs must be tokenized before LLM calls. Aligns with GDPR and local privacy requirements for retail operations.
